profile_text.body:
Perplexity is a for-profit startup founded in 2022 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. On its own site the company describes Perplexity as a free AI-powered answer engine that provides accurate, trusted, and real-time answers to any question.

Its tracked products are Perplexity AI, described as a search-augmented LLM, and Perplexity Enterprise Pro, an enterprise search product whose listed features include internal knowledge search, data indexing, SSO, and audit logs. Two MCP servers are also listed: ai.perplexity/mcp-server, described as real-time web search, reasoning, and research through Perplexity's API, and ai.smithery/arjunkmrm-perplexity-search, which enables AI assistants to perform web searches using Perplexity's Sonar Pro.

The company is a party to a number of federal cases. These include Gagleard v. Perplexity AI, Inc. in the District Court for the Northern District of California and in the Eastern District of California, Noel v. Perplexity AI, Inc. in the Northern District of California, Cable News Network Inc v. Perplexity AI, Inc., The New York Times Company v. Perplexity AI, Inc., Chicago Tribune Company, LLC v. Perplexity AI, Inc., and Encyclopaedia Britannica, Inc. v. Perplexity AI, Inc., all in the Southern District of New York, and Amazon.com Services LLC v. Perplexity AI, Inc. in the Northern District of California, with a related Amazon.com Services, LLC v. Perplexity AI, Inc. matter before the Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. California is the state where its litigation exposure is concentrated.
